Decision threshold (LC) defined as 1.05 × background concentration (background = 5.24 ppm)
Helium concentration in ambient air measured in real-time after background correction. Values below the decision threshold (LC) are reported as < LC.
Flag indicating whether the real-time background-corrected helium concentration is above or below the decision threshold (LC). Values are significant (≥ LC) or <LC (< LC).
Helium concentration in the sample after background correction. Values below the decision threshold (LC) are reported as < LC.
Flag indicating whether the background-corrected helium concentration measured from discrete air sampling is above or below the decision threshold (LC). Values are significant (≥ LC) or <LC (< LC).
Helium concentration in the sampled air after background and plume passage corrections. Calculated only when the background-corrected concentration is significant (≥ LC) and set to NA otherwise.
